literal: Purity, support, possession of courage, truthfulness with these three, [are] the quality of him who speaks the way.
translation: Purity, resourceful support, and courage, along with truthfulness, are the defining qualities of an envoy who delivers a message.
modern: தூய்மை, தகுந்த துணை, துணிவு ஆகியவற்றுடன் உண்மையாகவும் இருப்பது ஒரு தூதுவனின் சிறந்த பண்புகளாகும்.
explanation: This couplet lists the essential qualities of an envoy (வழி உரைப்பான்). They must possess purity of character (தூய்மை), the support of resourceful companions (துணைமை), and unwavering courage (துணிவு). Along with these three (இம்மூன்றின்), unfailing truthfulness (வாய்மை) completes the nature (பண்பு) of a perfect ambassador.
